Subject: Preschool Field Trip to the Minneapolis Zoo – Sat, Dec 13

Hi families,

We’re excited to take our preschool class on a field trip to the **Minneapolis Zoo** on **Saturday, December 13, 2025**, from **9:00 AM to 12:00 PM**.

We’ll meet at the zoo at **9:00 AM**, explore several preschool-friendly exhibits, have a mid-morning snack and bathroom break, and plan to finish and head out by **12:00 PM**.

Please send your child with:
- Comfortable walking shoes and weather-appropriate layers (light jacket)  
- A labeled water bottle  
- A peanut-free snack in a labeled container  
- Any necessary medications clearly labeled and handed to an adult at drop-off

Thank you,

[Contact Info]
